item.description: The City Commission will present a Fire Prevention Week Proclamation to the Coral Springs-Parkland Fire Department. This year, the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) has announced the theme, "Charge into Fire Safety: Safe Charging is a Superpower," which seeks to educate everyone about lithium-ion battery safety. The campaign stresses the importance of properly charging, purchasing, and recycling lithium-ion batteries. This year's Fire Prevention Week theme also provides helpful tips for safely using lithium-ion batteries, including using manufacturer-approved chargers, charging devices on hard, flat surfaces, and unplugging devices when they are fully charged. Fire Prevention Week 2026 is October 4-10.

item.title: Parkland · 2025-10-08 · October 8, 2025 City Commission Meeting (City Commission): Fire Prevention Week Proclamation
item.description: The City Commission will present a Fire Prevention Week Proclamation to the Coral Springs-Parkland Fire Department. This year's theme, “Charge into Fire Safety: Lithium-Ion Batteries in Your Home,” seeks to educate everyone about using lithium-ion batteries safely. The campaign stresses how important it is to buy, charge, and recycle these batteries safely. Helpful tips for safely using lithium-ion batteries include using manufacturer-approved chargers, charging devices on hard, flat surfaces, and unplugging devices when they are fully charged. Fire Prevention Week 2025 is October 5-11.
